scripts.text:
[Guide Soldier]
May the endless glory be with the Kingdom of Rune-Midgarts and its seven royal families!
Welcome to Gloria, the fortress in Siege Battle TE. We provide services in cooperation with Kafra and the major royal families of the kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[向导士兵]
愿无尽的荣耀与卢恩·米德加兹王国及七大王族同在！
欢迎来到攻城战TE的要塞格洛丽亚。我们与卡普拉及王国的各大王族合作，为您提供服务。

scripts.text: Gloria?
scripts.translation: 格洛丽亚？

scripts.text: About Siege Battle TE
scripts.translation: 关于攻城战TE

scripts.text: About requirements for participation
scripts.translation: 关于参与条件

scripts.text: Forget it.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Guide Soldier]
It has been named in honor of the seven royal families and the kingdom.
The whole city closely resembles Valkyrie Realm, and here resides the aspirations of the royal family for everyone.
scripts.translation:
[向导士兵]
这个名字是为了纪念七大王族和王国而取的。
整座城市与瓦尔基里雷恩十分相似，这里寄托着王族对所有人的期望。

scripts.text:
[Guide Soldier]
In Kafragarten of Aldebaran, managed by Gloria and Kafra Service, we have special rules that are slightly different from the existing ones.
We call it Siege Battle TE.
scripts.translation:
[向导士兵]
在由格洛丽亚和卡普拉服务管理的艾尔帕兰卡普拉贾登，我们实行一些与现有规则略有不同的特别规定。
我们称之为攻城战TE。

scripts.text:
[Guide Soldier]
You should not have troubles understanding the new rules since it is simply about setting a limit on qualifications for participation.
scripts.translation:
[向导士兵]
新规则只是对参与资格设定了限制，所以理解起来应该不难。

scripts.text:
[Guide Soldier]
It is a new stage prepared by the royal family in order to let more people participate in siege battles.
Different rules are applied, and sufficient supports are provided since its atmosphere is similar to that of a gymnasium.
scripts.translation:
[向导士兵]
这是王族为了让更多人参与攻城战而准备的新舞台。
这里的氛围类似于体育馆，所以适用不同的规则，并提供充足的支援。

scripts.text:
[Guide Soldier]
^4d4dffTertiary job class and users with expanded levels are not allowed in Gloria and Kafragarten regions, where Siege Battle TE rules are applied.^000000
scripts.translation:
[向导士兵]
^4d4dff在适用攻城战TE规则的格洛丽亚和卡普拉贾登地区，三转职业及扩展等级的玩家不得进入。^000000

scripts.text:
[Guide Soldier]
Also, we lend a variety of battlegears that you use only in corresponding regions for free.
This may be the biggest difference.
scripts.translation:
[向导士兵]
此外，我们会免费出借各种只能在相应地区使用的战斗装备。
这可能是最大的不同之处。

scripts.text:
[Guide Soldier]
^4d4dffNovice, primary, and secondary job classes are allowed to participate as well as extra job class.^000000
Of course, primary and secondary job classes are included as well.
scripts.translation:
[向导士兵]
^4d4dff初心者、一转和二转职业，以及扩展职业都可以参与。^000000
当然，一转和二转的进阶职业也包括在内。

scripts.text:
[Guide Soldier]
In other words, tertiary job class and jobs with expanded levels such as Kagerou and Oboro are not allowed.
Also, their buff effects get eliminated here.
scripts.translation:
[向导士兵]
换句话说，三转职业以及影狼、胧等扩展等级的职业不得参与。
此外，他们的增益效果在这里会被消除。

scripts.text:
[Guide Soldier]
Other than that, it is not much different from the existing siege battles.
scripts.translation:
[向导士兵]
除此之外，与现有的攻城战没有太大区别。

scripts.text:
[Guide Soldier]
May the glory of the royal family and Odin's protection be with you!
scripts.translation:
[向导士兵]
愿王族的荣耀与奥丁的庇佑与您同在！

scripts.text:
[Guide Soldier]
This warp gate here will let you go into Gloria region.
Please keep in mind that you are supposed to travel through warps here.
scripts.translation:
[向导士兵]
通过这里的传送门可以进入格洛丽亚地区。
请记住，在这里需要通过传送门移动。

scripts.text:
[Guide Soldier]
You are now at the fortress in Gloria.
If you wish to return to Valkyrie Realm, you can travel through warp.
scripts.translation:
[向导士兵]
您现在位于格洛丽亚的要塞。
如果想返回瓦尔基里雷恩，可以通过传送门移动。

scripts.text:
[Guide Soldier]
Welcome to Gloria.
Job classes that are allowed to participate in siege battles at the fortresses in Kafragarten and Gloria regions are limited to ^4d4dffprimary and secondary job classes as well as those without expanded levels.^000000
scripts.translation:
[向导士兵]
欢迎来到格洛丽亚。
在卡普拉贾登和格洛丽亚地区的要塞攻城战中，能参与的职业仅限于^4d4dff一转、二转职业以及没有扩展等级的职业。^000000

scripts.text:
[Guide Soldier]
In Kafragarten and Gloria regions, you get separate missions.
Some of them are not related to Emperiums, so challenge yourself!
scripts.translation:
[向导士兵]
在卡普拉贾登和格洛丽亚地区，有单独的任务。
其中有些与华丽金属无关，挑战一下吧！

scripts.text:
[Guide Soldier]
The royal family and Kafra Service have prepared a variety of retal items for you.
Although the rental period is relatively short, it's all free. So, don't miss the chance!
scripts.translation:
[向导士兵]
王族和卡普拉服务为您准备了各种租借物品。
虽然租借期限比较短，但全部免费。所以，不要错过机会！

scripts.text:
[Sorin]
Welcome to Kafra Service~ We always provide the best to our customers.
Finally, Kafra Service has established its own fortress!
scripts.translation:
[索林]
欢迎光临卡普拉服务~ 我们始终为顾客提供最好的服务。
卡普拉服务终于有了自己的要塞！

scripts.text: What is Kafragarten?
scripts.translation: 什么是卡普拉贾登？

scripts.text: What is Siege Battle TE?
scripts.translation: 什么是攻城战TE？

scripts.text: Qualifications for participation
scripts.translation: 参与资格

scripts.text: Forget it.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Sorin]
This is a fortress provided by Kafra Service in cooperation with the royal family of Rune-Midgarts.
It means 'Kafra's garden.'
scripts.translation:
[索林]
这是卡普拉服务与卢恩·米德加兹王族合作提供的要塞。
它的名字意为“卡普拉的花园”。

scripts.text:
[Sorin]
Although it looks very similar to Luina
It should be fine since it's servicing different users.
It's like a training stage, so to speak.
scripts.translation:
[索林]
虽然它看起来和露伊娜非常相似，但服务的对象不同，所以应该没问题。
可以说，它就像是一个训练场。

scripts.text:
[Sorin]
Kafragarten is built in the region of Luina, and in Valkyrie Realm, the royal family's Gloria is founded.
Kafra Service hopes that you would gain valuable experience in this new fortress.
scripts.translation:
[索林]
卡普拉贾登建在露伊娜地区，而王族的格洛丽亚建在瓦尔基里雷恩。
卡普拉服务希望您能在这座新要塞中获得宝贵的经验。

scripts.text:
[Sorin]
Siege Battle TE is ^4d4dffsiege battles designed for primary and secondary job classes only, ruling out tertiary job class.^000000
scripts.translation:
[索林]
攻城战TE是^4d4dff专为一转和二转职业设计的攻城战，三转职业不能参加。^000000

scripts.text:
[Sorin]
It's been newly established in an effort to allow more users to gain experience through siege battles.
scripts.translation:
[索林]
设立它是为了让更多玩家能通过攻城战积累经验。

scripts.text:
[Sorin]
Moreover, for your convenience, we lend a variety of items that you can use only inside the corresponding fortress. So, take advantage of this opportunity.
scripts.translation:
[索林]
此外，为了方便大家，我们还出借各种只能在相应要塞内使用的物品。请好好利用这个机会。

scripts.text:
[Sorin]
As they say, 'action speaks louder than words.'
Now, go and see for yourself~
scripts.translation:
[索林]
俗话说，“百闻不如一见”。
现在，请亲自去看看吧~

scripts.text:
[Sorin]
Primary, secondary, and extra job classes without expanded levels as well as primary and secondary job classes are allowed to participate only.
scripts.translation:
[索林]
只有一转、二转及没有扩展等级的扩展职业，以及一转、二转的进阶职业可以参与。

scripts.text:
[Sorin]
In other words, tertiary job class and jobs with expanded levels such as Kagerou and Oboro are not allowed.
scripts.translation:
[索林]
也就是说，三转职业以及影狼、胧等扩展等级的职业不能参与。

scripts.text:
[Sorin]
Kafra Service will do its utmost to bring joy to your life through Kafragarten.
scripts.translation:
[索林]
卡普拉服务将竭尽全力，通过卡普拉贾登为您的生活带来欢乐。

scripts.text:
[Defolty]
Kafragarten is like a mirrored image of Luina, so its structure is exactly the same as that of Luina.
scripts.translation:
[德福尔蒂]
卡普拉贾登就像露伊娜的镜像，所以它的结构与露伊娜完全相同。

scripts.text:
[Defolty]
You can travel by these warps here.
You can travel to Kafragarten using warp.
scripts.translation:
[德福尔蒂]
您可以通过这里的传送门移动。
通过传送门可以前往卡普拉贾登。

scripts.text:
[W]
You can travel to Luina using this warp here.
Make good use of it
scripts.translation:
[W]
通过这里的传送门可以前往露伊娜。
请好好利用

scripts.text:
[W]
Who took the castle that was named after me, W?
Hehe doesn't it mean that I'm superior to Tailing?
scripts.translation:
[W]
是谁占领了以我W命名的城堡？
嘿嘿，这不就说明我比泰灵更厉害吗？

scripts.text:
[Tailing]
This is the region of Kafragarten.
In siege battles in the regions of Kafragarten and Gloria, only primary and secondary job classes as well as users without expanded levels are allowed to participate.
scripts.translation:
[泰灵]
这里是卡普拉贾登地区。
在卡普拉贾登和格洛丽亚地区的攻城战中，只有一转、二转职业以及没有扩展等级的玩家可以参与。

scripts.text:
[Tailing]
... .
In Kafragarten and Gloria regions, you get separate missions.
So you should pay close attention.
scripts.translation:
[泰灵]
...
在卡普拉贾登和格洛丽亚地区，有单独的任务。
所以请多加留意。

scripts.text:
[Tailing]
Also, we have prepared a variety of battlegears, which are available anytime upon your request.
scripts.translation:
[泰灵]
此外，我们准备了各种战斗装备，您随时可以申请使用。

scripts.text:
[Tailing]
But obviously, they're only valid in the regions of Kafragarten and Gloria.
scripts.translation:
[泰灵]
不过显然，它们只在卡普拉贾登和格洛丽亚地区有效。

scripts.text:
[Tailing]
... ..
Ah if you think I'm mad because my name is missing from Kafragarten and if my way of speaking is a little stiff because of that
scripts.translation:
[泰灵]
...
啊，如果你觉得我因为卡普拉贾登里没有我的名字而生气，所以说话有点生硬的话

scripts.text:
[Tailing]
Oh my.
Is that really true?
No way. W is no better than me..hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[泰灵]
天哪。
真的是这样吗？
不可能。W才不比我强...哈哈哈。
